content_sections.heading: PDCC Bank Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Pune District Central Co-operative Bank (PDCC Bank) Recruitment 2026 for 7 posts of Driver has been announced. Candidates who have passed at least the 7th standard and possess a valid LMV-TR driving licence with the required driving experience can Apply Online. The online application opens on 03-11-2026 and ends on 07-11-2026. Eligible candidates who are original residents of Pune district can apply through the official website, driver.punedccbank.com.

PDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Age Limit Minimum Age: 23 Years Maximum Age: 38 Years Age Calculated As On: 01-11-2026 Upper age relaxation applies to candidates with at least 3 consecutive years of driving experience in a bank, as specified in the notification.

Qualification Candidates must have passed at least 7th Standard . Must possess a valid LMV-TR Driving Licence . Must have at least 3 Years of experience driving a heavy or light four-wheeler. Must possess basic and technical knowledge of vehicle maintenance and operation. Must be physically fit and capable of performing Driver duties. Must have knowledge of the geographical areas of Pune district. Must be an original resident of Pune district for at least 15 Years and provide the required residence certificate.
Salary Probation Period: 6 Months Probation Remuneration: Rs. 24,000/- Per Month After Probation: Salary and benefits as per the applicable bank pay scale and service rules.

Selection Process Technical Examination: 70 Marks Written Examination (Marathi MCQ): 20 Marks Track Driving Test: 25 Marks On-Road Driving Test: 25 Marks Document Verification Interview: 30 Marks Final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the technical examination and interview, subject to the prescribed qualifying requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for the Driver recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Pune District Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Pune (PDCC Bank) for filling vacant driver positions under its co-operative department regular service.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced for the Driver post?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies have been officially announced for the Driver position under the Pune District Central Co-operative Bank Limited recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Driver position must have passed at least the 7th standard along with a valid LMV-TR driving licence and a minimum of 3 years of driving experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PDCC Bank Driver post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 23 years and 38 years of age as on 01-10-2026. This age boundary must be strictly satisfied by all general category candidates applying.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1950/- along with applicable 18% GST and service charges through online payment modes like UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card.

faq.question: Q6. What are the starting and closing dates for online registration?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 03 November 2026 and concludes on 17 November 2026, which is the final deadline for form submission and fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for PDCC Bank Drivers?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a technical test including a written examination (20 marks), a track test (25 marks), an on-road test (25 marks), document verification, and a personal interview (30 marks).

faq.question: Q8. What salary will candidates receive during the probation period?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed on a probation period of six months during which they will receive a consolidated monthly salary amounting to Rs. 24,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is local residency mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be permanent residents of Pune district for at least 15 years, and 100% priority is extended to native residents fulfilling all other criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can eligible candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications online through the official website portals at https://www.pdcc.bank.in/careers or https://www.driver.punedccbank.com before the deadline.
